instructions.title: How to Play
instructions.subtitle: Build an automated mining empire to maximize Silver production!
instructions.step1Text: Start by manually clicking the iron mining button
instructions.step2Text: Automate iron production (cost increases every 10 miners)
instructions.step3Text: Use iron to buy sulfur and drills
instructions.step5Text: Automate Silver production to max out! (cost increases every 10 miners)
instructions.tip1d: stay active while tab remains open.
instructions.ironDesc: is the basic resource, mined manually or with miners
instructions.sulfurDesc: costs 50 iron, consumed when mining silver
instructions.drillsDesc: cost 500 iron, consumed when mining silver
instructions.silverDesc: is the premium resource, used to buy silver miners
instructions.tip2d: if you do not have the resources to buy or automate.

meta.title: Autominer | Vindrogames
meta.description: Autominer Idle Game by Vindrogames. Automate mining, leave your tab open, and max out!
